summary: Iter153 backend regression after mass unused-import purge + services/subscription_common.py extraction + 8-file refactor. Ran 31 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter153_refactor_regression.py — 31/31 PASSED on clean state. Coverage: (a) 12 admin GET smoke endpoints on tenant miracurl-marathahalli (reports/dashboard, appointments, services, customers, staff, products, invoices, settings/tax, services/banner-schedules, color-picks, gift-cards, billing/subscription-status) all 200; notifications/new-bookings 200. (b) Public: /public/plans 200, /public/salon/miracurl-marathahalli 200, /public/color/miracurl-marathahalli 200, /public/pay-link/<bogus> returns 404 (NOT 500 — pay_links.py + subscription_common import path is healthy). (c) Full booking→billing→completed flow: POST /public/book/miracurl-marathahalli (svc d658..2327, 2026-09-17T12:00:00+05:30) 200; admin GET appointment 200; POST /invoices with appointment_id 200; appointment then reads status=completed AND completed_via=billing; GET /appointments/billing-status?ids= lists it. (d) Staff role (priya.staff@miracurl.com): GET /customers 200 with projection that is a STRICT subset of {id,name,phone,gender,loyalty_points,wallet_balance,referral_code,visits,crm_status,created_at} — no email/notes/address/total_spent leaked; /settings/tax 200; POST /gift-cards/check {code:GC-NOPE} returns 200 valid:false (any-logged-in policy works); /notifications/new-bookings 200. (e) Super-admin (super@miracurl.com, no slug): /founder-funnel 200 with all 9 required keys (sent, opened, replied, live, logged_in, rated, avg_rating, paid, salons); /plans 200; /subscriptions 200; /rewards-campaign/agreements 200. (f) POST /cash/send-report?date=2026-09-12 200 with sent/failed/skipped keys (preview-silenced, no 500). (g) POST /settings/rewards-campaign/agreement/accept: agree:false → 400 'Tick I agree'; agree:true → 400 'already accepted' (idempotent path, NOT 500). (h) GET /reports/morning-briefing 200 (indirect email-HTML builder smoke). No 500/NameError/ImportError observed on any tested endpoint. Backend err log contains stale NameError(get_current_user in gift_cards.check_gift_card) and ImportError(RAZORPAY_KEY_ID from subscription_common) traces from BEFORE the fix — current source has both symbols correctly exported/imported (subscription_common.py line 12 re-exports RAZORPAY_KEY_ID from services.billing; gift_cards.py line 4 imports get_current_user from security).
critical_code_review_comments: services/subscription_common.py imports RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/SECRET/_rzp_client from services.billing then re-exports via __all__ — clean pattern, but subscriptions.py and pay_links.py both import these symbols from subscription_common instead of billing; consider documenting that subscription_common is the single import surface to keep pay_links↔subscriptions cycle broken.
Invoice schema requires BOTH 'type' and 'kind' fields on line items (422 if 'type' missing). If they represent the same concept, alias one of them or drop 'kind'; current shape is redundant.
Rewards agreement accept POST validates full_name min_length=3 with a raw 422 (Pydantic default). For consistency with the custom 'Tick I agree' 400 flow, consider a 400 with a friendlier message.
Duplicate-bill guard (409 within N minutes) fires on re-run of the same appointment_id — good defensive behaviour; retained.
seed_data_creation: One test appointment created for phone 9000000153 on 2026-09-17T12:00 IST via /public/book/miracurl-marathahalli, then billed via /invoices (INV auto-numbered). Appointment now status=completed. Also created 1 rewards-campaign agreement acceptance row (harmless, idempotent on re-run).
